items.title: Iris Ohyama data cloud breach exposes info of 7.7 million customers
items.snippet: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama, the operator of the Iris Plaza shopping platform, disclosed that personal information belonging to about 7.7 million people may have been exposed after unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service the company used. [...]
items.summary: Iris Ohyama disclosed that personal information belonging to about 7.7 million people may have been exposed after unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service.
items.why: Review third-party cloud access and investigate whether personal information was exposed.

items.title: Naval Group to Build UCUV Underwater Combat Drone Demonstrator for French Navy
items.snippet: Naval Group will build an operational Unmanned Combat Underwater Vehicle (UCUV) demonstrator for the French Navy, with sea trials scheduled to begin in 2028. The post Naval Group to Build UCUV Underwater Combat Drone Demonstrator for French Navy appeared first on Naval News .
items.summary: Naval Group will build an operational underwater combat drone demonstrator for the French Navy, with sea trials scheduled to begin in 2028.
items.why: The demonstrator highlights an underwater uncrewed capability being developed for naval operations.

items.title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
items.snippet: Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows damage to the building in the capital's central financial district.
items.summary: BBC Verify authenticated footage showing damage to a building in Riyadh’s central financial district, following fresh strikes launched by the Houthis, according to the headline.
items.why: Damage in a capital’s financial district highlights the location’s strategic and economic significance.

items.title: Moldova launches new power line to Romania to cut reliance on Russia
items.snippet: Moldovan President Maia Sandu says 'two more power lines to Romania are on the way'.
items.summary: Moldova has launched a new power line to Romania to reduce reliance on Russia. President Maia Sandu says two more lines are on the way.
items.why: The connection may diversify Moldova’s electricity links and reduce reliance on Russia.

items.title: Drone attack on Iraqi Kurdistan gas field triggers mass blackout
items.snippet: A drone attack has halted production at the Khor Mor gas field in northern Iraq, causing widespread power outages.
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports a drone attack halted production at the Khor Mor gas field in northern Iraq and caused widespread power outages.
items.why: The attack shows how disruption at a gas field can affect regional electricity supply.

items.title: Drone attack suspends production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gasfield
items.snippet: The strike leaves more than 70 percent of northern Iraq's Kurdish region without power.
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports a strike suspended production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gas field, leaving more than 70 percent of the Kurdish region without power.
items.why: The reported outage underscores the regional impact of disruption to energy infrastructure.

items.title: Iran war live: Trump to talk to Xi, Putin about Tehran, ‘denuclearisation’
items.snippet: Trump says Iran land blockade is now in effect, as Tehran threatens to 'rain down hell' if US resumes attacks.
items.summary: Trump says a land blockade on Iran is in effect and that he will talk to Xi and Putin about Tehran. Tehran threatens retaliation if the US resumes attacks.
items.why: The statements indicate a diplomatic and military standoff involving Iran, the US, China and Russia.

items.title: Nvidia CEO’s affair sparks Chinese espionage probe
items.snippet: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.
items.summary: The headline reports a Chinese espionage probe after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.
items.why: The reported probe illustrates how alleged espionage concerns can intersect with business and personal relationships.

items.title: Deadly sand cliff collapses on displaced families in Gaza

items.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says there has been no progress in talks with the US.

learn.explainer: A cloud breach is unauthorized access to information stored in a cloud service. The title describes customer information as exposed, but gives no further details about how it happened.
A drone attack is an attack carried out using a drone. In the Khor Mor report, a drone attack is linked to halted gas production and power outages.
A power line carries electricity between places. The Moldova report describes a new line to Romania as a way to cut reliance on Russia.

analysis.headline: Infrastructure, interdependence and regional tensions
paragraphs: Several stories center on infrastructure exposed to disruption or strategic pressure. The reported damage to a building in Riyadh’s financial district and the attack on Iraq’s Khor Mor gas field show different forms of risk to important sites. The available reports do not establish a connection between these events.

The Khor Mor accounts link halted production with power outages, while Moldova’s new line to Romania points to another aspect of infrastructure security: supply links. Sandu says two additional lines are planned. For analysts, these stories suggest tracking both the condition of critical facilities and the routes that connect energy systems.

The Iran blockade statements and the reported Chinese espionage probe add diplomatic and security tensions to an already varied picture. Their details remain limited here. Defenders and analysts should distinguish confirmed reporting from attributed claims, and watch for further reporting on infrastructure disruption, energy connections and official statements.
takeaways: Separate authenticated footage from claims about responsibility or consequences.
Track both energy facilities and the links that supply power.
Treat attributed statements as claims, and watch for further reporting.
